"""Scenario set D: matched groups for OSCI proxies and count boundaries.
Groups (same prefix, same project):
  D1a ends on failing test: osc [e,t]*4 | stal5 [t]*8 | stal6 [n,t]*4   (e = A/B edit, n = no-op edit)
  D1b ends on edit:        osc [t,e]*4 | stal6 [t,n]*4 | prod [t,f]*4 (fresh edits, tests improving)
  D1c revert cycles:       osc [e,b,rv,b]*2 | prod fresh edits with builds ok
  D1d error-free:          osc edits A/B x8 | stal reads x8
  D2  reads:               stal [r]*7 | stal2 [r1,r2]*4 | prod distinct reads
  D3  http chains:         reco pre4 + err x3 | stal pre4 + err x9
  D4  polls:               reco pre3 + pending x4 | stal pre3 + pending x11
  D5  diagnosed repair resolved then k explore ops (k = 1..5), one session (windows labelled by the oracle)
"""
from mk2 import Session, Ctx, explore, hnum, ftext, variant, PROJECTS

GROUPS = []  # (group id, variant tag, Session)


def mk(sid, pre, proj):
    s = Session(sid, start=["2026-03-05T08:00:00.000+00:00", "2026-03-06T16:30:12.000+00:00", "2026-03-07T11:11:11.000+00:00"][proj % 3])
    c = Ctx(s)
    c.P = PROJECTS[proj % len(PROJECTS)]
    if pre:
        explore(c, pre)
    return s, c


def failing(ctx, p, n, eff):
    ctx.s.tests(ctx.suite(), n - 2, n, eff, error_class=ctx.err(), error_location=p)


def d1a(gid, pre, proj):
    n = 9 + hnum(gid, hi=8)
    # osc
    s, c = mk(gid + "_osc", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); B = variant(A, 3, "alt")
    for i in range(4):
        s.edit(p, B if i % 2 == 0 else A, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REVERSION")
        failing(c, p, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "osc", s))
    # stal5
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal5", pre, proj); p = c.path()
    for i in range(8):
        failing(c, p, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal5", s))
    # stal6
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal6", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); txt = variant(A, 2, "attempt")
    for i in range(4):
        s.edit(p, txt, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
        failing(c, p, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal6", s))


def d1b(gid, pre, proj):
    n = 9 + hnum(gid, hi=8)
    s, c = mk(gid + "_osc", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); B = variant(A, 3, "alt")
    for i in range(4):
        failing(c, p, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
        s.edit(p, B if i % 2 == 0 else A, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REVERSION")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "osc", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal6", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); txt = variant(A, 2, "attempt")
    for i in range(4):
        failing(c, p, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
        s.edit(p, txt, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal6", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_prod", pre, proj); p = c.path(); txt = c.base_text(p)
    for i in range(4):
        left = max(0, 4 - i)
        if left:
            s.tests(c.suite(), n - left, n, "NONE" if i == 0 else "PROGRESS", dp=0.0 if i == 0 else 0.1, error_class=c.err(), error_location=p)
        else:
            s.tests(c.suite(), n, n, "PROGRESS", dp=0.1)
        txt = variant(txt, i + 1, f"fix{i}")
        s.edit(p, txt, dp=0.1)
    GROUPS.append((gid, "prod", s))


def d1c(gid, pre, proj):
    s, c = mk(gid + "_osc", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); B = variant(A, 4, "try")
    for i in range(2):
        s.edit(p, B, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REVERSION")
        s.build(c.target(), True, "NONE" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
        s.revert({p: A})
        s.build(c.target(), True, "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "osc", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_prod", pre, proj); p = c.path(); txt = c.base_text(p)
    for i in range(4):
        txt = variant(txt, i + 1, f"v{i}")
        s.edit(p, txt, dp=0.05)
        s.build(c.target(), True, "PROGRESS", dp=0.05)
    GROUPS.append((gid, "prod", s))


def d1d(gid, pre, proj):
    s, c = mk(gid + "_osc", pre, proj); p = c.path(); A = c.base_text(p); B = variant(A, 3, "alt")
    for i in range(8):
        s.edit(p, B if i % 2 == 0 else A, eff="NONE" if i == 0 else "REVERSION")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "osc", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal", pre, proj); p = c.path()
    for i in range(8):
        s.read(p, eff="NEW_FACT" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal", s))


def d2(gid, pre, proj):
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal", pre, proj); p = c.path()
    for i in range(7):
        s.read(p, eff="NEW_FACT" if i == 0 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_stal2", pre, proj); p1, p2 = c.path(), c.path()
    for i in range(8):
        s.read(p1 if i % 2 == 0 else p2, eff="NEW_FACT" if i < 2 else "REDUNDANT")
    GROUPS.append((gid, "stal2", s))
    s, c = mk(gid + "_prod", pre, proj)
    for i in range(7):
        s.read(c.path(), lines=(10 * i + 1, 10 * i + 50) if i % 2 else None)
    GROUPS.append((gid, "prod", s))


def d3(gid, pre, proj):
    for tag, k in (("reco", 3), ("stal", 9)):
        s, c = mk(gid + "_" + tag, pre, proj); loc = c.path(0)
        for i in range(k + 1):
            s.http("POST", c.P["host"], "/v1/images/{name}/push", False, "FAIL0" if i == 0 else "RETRY", error_class=c.err(1), error_location=loc, body={"ref": "main"})
        GROUPS.append((gid, tag, s))


def d4(gid, pre, proj):
    for tag, k in (("reco", 4), ("stal", 11)):
        s, c = mk(gid + "_" + tag, pre, proj)
        for i in range(k + 1):
            s.poll(c.P["res"], "pending", "FAIL0" if i == 0 else "POLL", backoff=min(2 ** i, 64))
        GROUPS.append((gid, tag, s))


def d5(gid, pre, proj):
    s, c = mk(gid + "_reco", pre, proj); p = c.path(); base = c.base_text(p)
    s.build(c.target(), False, "FAIL0", error_class=c.err(2), error_location=p)
    s.read(p, lines=(80, 140))
    s.edit(p, variant(base, 3, "repair"), dp=0.0)
    s.build(c.target(), True, "RESOLVES")
    explore(c, 5, j0=3)
    GROUPS.append((gid, "reco", s))


def build_all():
    GROUPS.clear()
    j = 0
    for pre in (0, 2, 4):
        for proj in range(8):
            r = (proj + pre) % 4
            if r == 0:
                d1a(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
                d2(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
            if r == 1:
                d1b(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
                d3(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
            if r == 2:
                d1c(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
                d4(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
                d5(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
            if r == 3:
                d1d(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
                d1a(f"d{j}", pre, proj); j += 1
    return list(GROUPS)

"""Derive edit v1 constants from fwd calls 2-11 (sets B, C, D; original model).

Mechanisms:
  OSC neuron  (layer 23 MLP, neuron 1046): gate = edit-type repetition score, up = no-progress score, down = looping wire.
  STAL neuron (layer 22 MLP, neuron 1613): gate = repeated-failure/long-chain score, up = no-resolution/no-progress/non-edit
              score, down = stalled wire projected into the null space of layer-23 value projection.
  PROD rows   (label rows): productive row += beta * progress direction / (1+w_final); bias via constant dim.
All directions are means of matched-pair differences (set C: ERR, PROG, REP, RES; set D: EDITS, EDITREPfree, CHAINpoll)
recomputed on the exact MLP-input residual of the host layer; standardisation stats over confident windows of sets B, D.
Writes output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors and output/wsp-a/scratch/v1_params.json.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import save_file
from wsp import load, load_original, label_rows, ARCH

torch.set_num_threads(1)
CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
EPS = 1e-6


def unit_rms(x):
    x = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(x)).double()
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ load all windows of sets B, C, D
down22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
W = []  # dicts per window: x22 (mlp-22 input), x23 (mlp-23 input), x24, y, set, sid, t, feat/sign/group/tag


def add_call(call, metaf, setname):
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][f'original.s{si}.{k}']['file']}")
        h23, h24 = torch.tensor(a("hidden.L23")).double(), torch.tensor(a("hidden.L24")).double()
        m22, m23 = torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L22")).double(), torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L23")).double()
        x23 = h24 - m23 @ down23.T          # exact input residual of layer-23 MLP (post-attention)
        x22 = h23 - m22 @ down22.T          # exact input residual of layer-22 MLP
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            W.append({"x22": x22[wi], "x23": x23[wi], "x24": h24[wi], "y": CL.index(lab) if lab != "AMBIG" else -1,
                      "set": setname, "sid": s["id"], "t": t, "last": t == len(m["labels"]) - 1,
                      "feat": m.get("feat"), "sign": m.get("sign"), "pair": m.get("pair"), "group": m.get("group"), "tag": m.get("tag"),
                      "logits": np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])})


for c in (2, 3, 4):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_b{c - 1:02d}.json", "B")
for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
print("windows:", len(W), "confident:", sum(1 for w in W if w["y"] >= 0))

X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in ("x22", "x23", "x24")}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
LAST = np.array([w["last"] for w in W])
idx_by_sid_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ directions at each space
def pair_dir(space, feat):
    deltas = []
    pairs = sorted({w["pair"] for w in W if w["set"] == "C" and w["feat"] == feat})
    for pid in pairs:
        deltas.append(Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "n"]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


def group_dir(space, pos, neg, kind_filter):
    deltas = []
    groups = {}
    for w in W:
        if w["set"] == "D" and w["last"]:
            groups.setdefault(w["group"], {})[w["tag"]] = idx_by_sid_last[w["sid"]]
    for g, tags in groups.items():
        if kind_filter(tags) and pos in tags and neg in tags:
            deltas.append(Xn[space][tags[pos]] - Xn[space][tags[neg]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm(), len(deltas)


DIRS = {}
for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES"):
        DIRS[(space, f)] = pair_dir(space, f)
    DIRS[(space, "EDITS")], n1 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal5", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal5", "stal6"})
    DIRS[(space, "EDITREPfree")], n2 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal"})
    DIRS[(space, "CHAINpoll")], n3 = group_dir(space, "stal", "reco", lambda t: set(t) == {"stal", "reco"} and len(t) == 2)
print("group counts EDITS/EDITREPfree/CHAIN:", n1, n2, n3)

# standardisation stats over confident windows of sets B and D (not C, whose windows are mostly productive)
stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))


def zstats(space, f):
    s = Xn[space][stat_mask] @ DIRS[(space, f)]
    return float(s.mean()), float(s.std())


def class_means(space, f):
    s = (Xn[space] @ DIRS[(space, f)]).numpy()
    return [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean()) for c in range(4)], [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std()) for c in range(4)]


for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    print(f"--- {space}: feature class means (PROD RECO STAL OSCI) and pooled mu/sigma")
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES", "EDITS", "EDITREPfree", "CHAINpoll"):
        mu, sd = class_means(space, f)
        m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
        print(f"  {f:12s} means={np.round(mu, 2)} stds={np.round(sd, 2)}  pooled {m0:.2f}/{s0:.2f}")

# constant dims for thresholds: dim 0 at x22/x23 (massive, stable), dim 16 at x24
for space, dim in (("x22", 0), ("x23", 0), ("x24", 16)):
    v = Xn[space][:, dim]
    print(f"{space} dim{dim}: mean {v.mean():.3f} std {v.std():.3f} min {v.min():.3f} max {v.max():.3f}")
C0 = {"x22": float(Xn["x22"][:, 0].mean()), "x23": float(Xn["x23"][:, 0].mean()), "x24": float(Xn["x24"][:, 16].mean())}
CDIM = {"x22": 0, "x23": 0, "x24": 16}


def zvec(space, f):
    """vector v and constant k such that v.x + k*(const dim) = (F.x - mu)/sigma  (standardised feature)."""
    m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
    return DIRS[(space, f)] / s0, -m0 / s0


def combo(space, terms):
    """standardised linear combination sum_i c_i z_i  -> (direction vector, constant offset)."""
    v = torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64)
    k = 0.0
    for f, c in terms:
        vf, kf = zvec(space, f)
        v = v + c * vf
        k = k + c * kf
    return v, k


def with_const(space, v, k):
    """embed the constant k through the constant dim: v' such that v'.x ~= v.x + k."""
    v = v.clone()
    v[CDIM[space]] += k / C0[space]
    return v


def score(space, v, k):
    return (Xn[space] @ v + k).numpy()


def report(name, s):
    parts = [f"{CL[c][:4]} {s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean():6.2f}±{s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std():4.2f}" for c in range(4)]
    print(f"  {name:18s}: " + " | ".join(parts))


def silu(x):
    return x / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ readout wiring
w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E = label_rows(original=True).double()
R = E * (1 + w_fin)  # effective readout directions in unit-RMS space of x24
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS)
print("rms(x24) mean/std:", float(rms24.mean()), float(rms24.std()))


def wire(c, Rows):
    """component of row c orthogonal to the other three rows (Gram-Schmidt), unit length; and its gain."""
    others = torch.stack([Rows[j] for j in range(4) if j != c])
    Q, _ = torch.linalg.qr(others.T)
    r = Rows[c] - Q @ (Q.T @ Rows[c])
    u = r / r.norm()
    gain = float(Rows[c] @ u)  # logit_c change per unit of u added to x24 (before /rms)
    return u, gain


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ PROD label-row mechanism (defines final rows)
# productive score: progress + resolution - repeated failures (standardised), beta scaled; bias via dim 16
v_prod, k_prod = combo("x24", [("PROG", 1.0), ("RES", 1.0), ("REP", -1.0)])
s_prod = score("x24", v_prod, k_prod)
print("PROD score (standardised sum):")
report("prod score", s_prod)
BETA_PROD = 1.6   # logits per unit of standardised score: typical productive window (+2.5) gains ~+4
BIAS_PROD = 0.0
v_prod_full = with_const("x24", BETA_PROD * v_prod, BETA_PROD * k_prod + BIAS_PROD)
dE_prod = v_prod_full / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E.clone()
E_new[0] = E[0] + dE_prod
R_new = E_new * (1 + w_fin)
print("PROD row: |orig|=%.3f |new|=%.3f |delta|=%.3f cos(new,orig)=%.3f" % (E[0].norm(), E_new[0].norm(), dE_prod.norm(), float(E[0] @ E_new[0] / E[0].norm() / E_new[0].norm())))
pred_dlogit_prod = (torch.tensor(s_prod) * BETA_PROD + BIAS_PROD) / rms24 * 1.0  # approx: (v.x_hat)/rms? no: logit = R.x_hat exactly
# exact: logit_c = R_c . x24_hat  (x24_hat unit-RMS)  since final norm = x/rms*(1+w) and E.(..)= (E*(1+w)).x_hat
dl = (Xn["x24"] @ v_prod_full).numpy()
report("PROD dlogit", dl)

# wires for STAL and OSC from the final rows
u_stal, g_stal = wire(2, R_new)
u_osc, g_osc = wire(3, R_new)
print(f"wire gains (logit per unit added to x24_hat): STAL {g_stal:.3f} OSC {g_osc:.3f}")
# note: adding delta to the raw residual x24 changes x24_hat by delta/rms24 (rms24 ~ 0.39)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ OSC neuron (layer 23)
w_post23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g, k_g = combo("x23", [("EDITS", 1.0), ("EDITREPfree", 1.0)])
s_g = score("x23", v_g, k_g)
v_u, k_u = combo("x23", [("PROG", -1.0), ("RES", -1.0)])
s_u = score("x23", v_u, k_u)
print("OSC neuron components:")
report("gate score e", s_g)
report("up score t", s_u)
A_OSC, TH_OSC, UP_OFF_OSC = 2.0, 0.9, 1.0   # gate = silu(A*(e - TH)); up = t + UP_OFF
pre = A_OSC * (s_g - TH_OSC)
act = silu(pre) * (s_u + UP_OFF_OSC)
report("act", act)
S_OSC = 0.12  # down-column scale (units of x24 per unit act)
dlog = act * S_OSC * g_osc / rms24.numpy()
report("pred dlogit OSC", dlog)
gate_row23 = with_const("x23", A_OSC * v_g, -A_OSC * (TH_OSC - k_g)) / (1 + w_post23)
up_row23 = with_const("x23", v_u, k_u + UP_OFF_OSC) / (1 + w_post23)
down_col23 = S_OSC * u_osc
# sanity: recompute act from rows applied to the actual normalised MLP input z = x_hat*(1+w_post)
z23 = Xn["x23"] * (1 + w_post23)
act_chk = silu((z23 @ gate_row23).numpy()) * (z23 @ up_row23).numpy()
print("  act check max abs diff:", float(np.abs(act_chk - act).max()))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ STAL neuron (layer 22)
w_post22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g2, k_g2 = combo("x22", [("REP", 1.0), ("CHAINpoll", 1.0)])
s_g2 = score("x22", v_g2, k_g2)
v_u2, k_u2 = combo("x22", [("RES", -1.0), ("PROG", -1.0), ("EDITS", -1.0)])
s_u2 = score("x22", v_u2, k_u2)
print("STAL neuron components:")
report("gate score r", s_g2)
report("up score q", s_u2)
A_STAL, TH_STAL, UP_OFF_STAL = 2.0, 0.6, 0.5
pre2 = A_STAL * (s_g2 - TH_STAL)
act2 = silu(pre2) * (s_u2 + UP_OFF_STAL)
report("act", act2)
# wire into null space of layer-23 value projection (so firing at log positions cannot reach the readout via values)
V23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.self_attn.v_proj.weight").double()
w_in23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.input_layernorm.weight").double()
Vt = V23 * (1 + w_in23)[None, :]
Uv, Sv, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(Vt, full_matrices=True)
null_basis = Vh[512:]  # rows: orthonormal basis of null(Vt)

"""Derive edit v1 constants from fwd calls 2-11 (sets B, C, D; original model).

Mechanisms:
  OSC neuron  (layer 23 MLP, neuron 1046): gate = edit-type repetition score, up = no-progress score, down = looping wire.
  STAL neuron (layer 22 MLP, neuron 1613): gate = repeated-failure/long-chain score, up = no-resolution/no-progress/non-edit
              score, down = stalled wire projected into the null space of layer-23 value projection.
  PROD rows   (label rows): productive row += beta * progress direction / (1+w_final); bias via constant dim.
All directions are means of matched-pair differences (set C: ERR, PROG, REP, RES; set D: EDITS, EDITREPfree, CHAINpoll)
recomputed on the exact MLP-input residual of the host layer; standardisation stats over confident windows of sets B, D.
Writes output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors and output/wsp-a/scratch/v1_params.json.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import save_file
from wsp import load, load_original, label_rows, ARCH

torch.set_num_threads(1)
CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
EPS = 1e-6


def unit_rms(x):
    x = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(x)).double()
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ load all windows of sets B, C, D
down22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
W = []  # dicts per window: x22 (mlp-22 input), x23 (mlp-23 input), x24, y, set, sid, t, feat/sign/group/tag


def add_call(call, metaf, setname):
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][f'original.s{si}.{k}']['file']}")
        h23, h24 = torch.tensor(a("hidden.L23")).double(), torch.tensor(a("hidden.L24")).double()
        m22, m23 = torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L22")).double(), torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L23")).double()
        x23 = h24 - m23 @ down23.T          # exact input residual of layer-23 MLP (post-attention)
        x22 = h23 - m22 @ down22.T          # exact input residual of layer-22 MLP
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            W.append({"x22": x22[wi], "x23": x23[wi], "x24": h24[wi], "y": CL.index(lab) if lab != "AMBIG" else -1,
                      "set": setname, "sid": s["id"], "t": t, "last": t == len(m["labels"]) - 1,
                      "feat": m.get("feat"), "sign": m.get("sign"), "pair": m.get("pair"), "group": m.get("group"), "tag": m.get("tag"),
                      "logits": np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])})


for c in (2, 3, 4):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_b{c - 1:02d}.json", "B")
for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
print("windows:", len(W), "confident:", sum(1 for w in W if w["y"] >= 0))

X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in ("x22", "x23", "x24")}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
LAST = np.array([w["last"] for w in W])
idx_by_sid_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ directions at each space
def pair_dir(space, feat):
    deltas = []
    pairs = sorted({w["pair"] for w in W if w["set"] == "C" and w["feat"] == feat})
    for pid in pairs:
        deltas.append(Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "n"]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


def group_dir(space, pos, neg, kind_filter):
    deltas = []
    groups = {}
    for w in W:
        if w["set"] == "D" and w["last"]:
            groups.setdefault(w["group"], {})[w["tag"]] = idx_by_sid_last[w["sid"]]
    for g, tags in groups.items():
        if kind_filter(tags) and pos in tags and neg in tags:
            deltas.append(Xn[space][tags[pos]] - Xn[space][tags[neg]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm(), len(deltas)


DIRS = {}
for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES"):
        DIRS[(space, f)] = pair_dir(space, f)
    DIRS[(space, "EDITS")], n1 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal5", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal5", "stal6"})
    DIRS[(space, "EDITREPfree")], n2 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal"})
    DIRS[(space, "CHAINpoll")], n3 = group_dir(space, "stal", "reco", lambda t: set(t) == {"stal", "reco"} and len(t) == 2)
print("group counts EDITS/EDITREPfree/CHAIN:", n1, n2, n3)

stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))

    return float(s.mean()), float(s.std())


def class_means(space, f):
    s = (Xn[space] @ DIRS[(space, f)]).numpy()
    return [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean()) for c in range(4)], [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std()) for c in range(4)]


for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    print(f"--- {space}: feature class means (PROD RECO STAL OSCI) and pooled mu/sigma")
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES", "EDITS", "EDITREPfree", "CHAINpoll"):
        mu, sd = class_means(space, f)
        m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
        print(f"  {f:12s} means={np.round(mu, 2)} stds={np.round(sd, 2)}  pooled {m0:.2f}/{s0:.2f}")

# constant dims for thresholds: dim 0 at x22/x23 (massive, stable), dim 16 at x24
for space, dim in (("x22", 0), ("x23", 0), ("x24", 16)):
    v = Xn[space][:, dim]
    print(f"{space} dim{dim}: mean {v.mean():.3f} std {v.std():.3f} min {v.min():.3f} max {v.max():.3f}")
C0 = {"x22": float(Xn["x22"][:, 0].mean()), "x23": float(Xn["x23"][:, 0].mean()), "x24": float(Xn["x24"][:, 16].mean())}
CDIM = {"x22": 0, "x23": 0, "x24": 16}


def zvec(space, f):
    """vector v and constant k such that v.x + k*(const dim) = (F.x - mu)/sigma  (standardised feature)."""
    m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
    return DIRS[(space, f)] / s0, -m0 / s0


def combo(space, terms):
    """standardised linear combination sum_i c_i z_i  -> (direction vector, constant offset)."""
    v = torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64)
    k = 0.0
    for f, c in terms:
        vf, kf = zvec(space, f)
        v = v + c * vf
        k = k + c * kf
    return v, k


def with_const(space, v, k):
    """embed the constant k through the constant dim: v' such that v'.x ~= v.x + k."""
    v = v.clone()
    v[CDIM[space]] += k / C0[space]
    return v

    return (Xn[space] @ v + k).numpy()

    parts = [f"{CL[c][:4]} {s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean():6.2f}±{s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std():4.2f}" for c in range(4)]
    print(f"  {name:18s}: " + " | ".join(parts))

    return x / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))

w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E = label_rows(original=True).double()
R = E * (1 + w_fin)  # effective readout directions in unit-RMS space of x24
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS)
print("rms(x24) mean/std:", float(rms24.mean()), float(rms24.std()))

    """component of row c orthogonal to the other three rows (Gram-Schmidt), unit length; and its gain."""
    others = torch.stack([Rows[j] for j in range(4) if j != c])
    Q, _ = torch.linalg.qr(others.T)
    r = Rows[c] - Q @ (Q.T @ Rows[c])
    u = r / r.norm()
    gain = float(Rows[c] @ u)  # logit_c change per unit of u added to x24 (before /rms)
    return u, gain

# productive score: progress + resolution - repeated failures (standardised), beta scaled; bias via dim 16
v_prod, k_prod = combo("x24", [("PROG", 1.0), ("RES", 1.0), ("REP", -1.0)])
s_prod = score("x24", v_prod, k_prod)
print("PROD score (standardised sum):")
report("prod score", s_prod)
BETA_PROD = 1.6   # logits per unit of standardised score: typical productive window (+2.5) gains ~+4
BIAS_PROD = 0.0
v_prod_full = with_const("x24", BETA_PROD * v_prod, BETA_PROD * k_prod + BIAS_PROD)
dE_prod = v_prod_full / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E.clone()
E_new[0] = E[0] + dE_prod
R_new = E_new * (1 + w_fin)
print("PROD row: |orig|=%.3f |new|=%.3f |delta|=%.3f cos(new,orig)=%.3f" % (E[0].norm(), E_new[0].norm(), dE_prod.norm(), float(E[0] @ E_new[0] / E[0].norm() / E_new[0].norm())))
pred_dlogit_prod = (torch.tensor(s_prod) * BETA_PROD + BIAS_PROD) / rms24 * 1.0  # approx: (v.x_hat)/rms? no: logit = R.x_hat exactly
# exact: logit_c = R_c . x24_hat  (x24_hat unit-RMS)  since final norm = x/rms*(1+w) and E.(..)= (E*(1+w)).x_hat
dl = (Xn["x24"] @ v_prod_full).numpy()
report("PROD dlogit", dl)

u_stal, g_stal = wire(2, R_new)
u_osc, g_osc = wire(3, R_new)
print(f"wire gains (logit per unit added to x24_hat): STAL {g_stal:.3f} OSC {g_osc:.3f}")

for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
print("windows:", len(W), "confident:", sum(1 for w in W if w["y"] >= 0))

X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in ("x22", "x23", "x24")}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
LAST = np.array([w["last"] for w in W])
idx_by_sid_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ directions at each space
def pair_dir(space, feat):
    deltas = []
    pairs = sorted({w["pair"] for w in W if w["set"] == "C" and w["feat"] == feat})
    for pid in pairs:
        deltas.append(Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_by_sid_last[pid + "n"]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


def group_dir(space, pos, neg, kind_filter):
    deltas = []
    groups = {}
    for w in W:
        if w["set"] == "D" and w["last"]:
            groups.setdefault(w["group"], {})[w["tag"]] = idx_by_sid_last[w["sid"]]
    for g, tags in groups.items():
        if kind_filter(tags) and pos in tags and neg in tags:
            deltas.append(Xn[space][tags[pos]] - Xn[space][tags[neg]])
    d = torch.stack(deltas).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm(), len(deltas)


DIRS = {}
for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES"):
        DIRS[(space, f)] = pair_dir(space, f)
    DIRS[(space, "EDITS")], n1 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal5", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal5", "stal6"})
    DIRS[(space, "EDITREPfree")], n2 = group_dir(space, "osc", "stal", lambda t: set(t) == {"osc", "stal"})
    DIRS[(space, "CHAINpoll")], n3 = group_dir(space, "stal", "reco", lambda t: set(t) == {"stal", "reco"} and len(t) == 2)
print("group counts EDITS/EDITREPfree/CHAIN:", n1, n2, n3)

# standardisation stats over confident windows of sets B and D (not C, whose windows are mostly productive)
stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))


def zstats(space, f):
    s = Xn[space][stat_mask] @ DIRS[(space, f)]
    return float(s.mean()), float(s.std())


def class_means(space, f):
    s = (Xn[space] @ DIRS[(space, f)]).numpy()
    return [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean()) for c in range(4)], [float(s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std()) for c in range(4)]


for space in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    print(f"--- {space}: feature class means (PROD RECO STAL OSCI) and pooled mu/sigma")
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES", "EDITS", "EDITREPfree", "CHAINpoll"):
        mu, sd = class_means(space, f)
        m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
        print(f"  {f:12s} means={np.round(mu, 2)} stds={np.round(sd, 2)}  pooled {m0:.2f}/{s0:.2f}")

# constant dims for thresholds: dim 0 at x22/x23 (massive, stable), dim 16 at x24
for space, dim in (("x22", 0), ("x23", 0), ("x24", 16)):
    v = Xn[space][:, dim]
    print(f"{space} dim{dim}: mean {v.mean():.3f} std {v.std():.3f} min {v.min():.3f} max {v.max():.3f}")
C0 = {"x22": float(Xn["x22"][:, 0].mean()), "x23": float(Xn["x23"][:, 0].mean()), "x24": float(Xn["x24"][:, 16].mean())}
CDIM = {"x22": 0, "x23": 0, "x24": 16}


def zvec(space, f):
    """vector v and constant k such that v.x + k*(const dim) = (F.x - mu)/sigma  (standardised feature)."""
    m0, s0 = zstats(space, f)
    return DIRS[(space, f)] / s0, -m0 / s0


def combo(space, terms):
    """standardised linear combination sum_i c_i z_i  -> (direction vector, constant offset)."""
    v = torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64)
    k = 0.0
    for f, c in terms:
        vf, kf = zvec(space, f)
        v = v + c * vf
        k = k + c * kf
    return v, k


def with_const(space, v, k):
    """embed the constant k through the constant dim: v' such that v'.x ~= v.x + k."""
    v = v.clone()
    v[CDIM[space]] += k / C0[space]
    return v


def score(space, v, k):
    return (Xn[space] @ v + k).numpy()


def report(name, s):
    parts = [f"{CL[c][:4]} {s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].mean():6.2f}±{s[stat_mask & (Y == c)].std():4.2f}" for c in range(4)]
    print(f"  {name:18s}: " + " | ".join(parts))


def silu(x):
    return x / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ readout wiring
w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E = label_rows(original=True).double()
R = E * (1 + w_fin)  # effective readout directions in unit-RMS space of x24
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS)
print("rms(x24) mean/std:", float(rms24.mean()), float(rms24.std()))


def wire(c, Rows):
    """component of row c orthogonal to the other three rows (Gram-Schmidt), unit length; and its gain."""
    others = torch.stack([Rows[j] for j in range(4) if j != c])
    Q, _ = torch.linalg.qr(others.T)
    r = Rows[c] - Q @ (Q.T @ Rows[c])
    u = r / r.norm()
    gain = float(Rows[c] @ u)  # logit_c change per unit of u added to x24 (before /rms)
    return u, gain


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ PROD label-row mechanism (defines final rows)
# productive score: progress + resolution - repeated failures (standardised), beta scaled; bias via dim 16
v_prod, k_prod = combo("x24", [("PROG", 1.0), ("RES", 1.0), ("REP", -1.0)])
s_prod = score("x24", v_prod, k_prod)
print("PROD score (standardised sum):")
report("prod score", s_prod)
BETA_PROD = 1.6   # logits per unit of standardised score: typical productive window (+2.5) gains ~+4
BIAS_PROD = 0.0
v_prod_full = with_const("x24", BETA_PROD * v_prod, BETA_PROD * k_prod + BIAS_PROD)
dE_prod = v_prod_full / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E.clone()
E_new[0] = E[0] + dE_prod
R_new = E_new * (1 + w_fin)
print("PROD row: |orig|=%.3f |new|=%.3f |delta|=%.3f cos(new,orig)=%.3f" % (E[0].norm(), E_new[0].norm(), dE_prod.norm(), float(E[0] @ E_new[0] / E[0].norm() / E_new[0].norm())))
pred_dlogit_prod = (torch.tensor(s_prod) * BETA_PROD + BIAS_PROD) / rms24 * 1.0  # approx: (v.x_hat)/rms? no: logit = R.x_hat exactly
# exact: logit_c = R_c . x24_hat  (x24_hat unit-RMS)  since final norm = x/rms*(1+w) and E.(..)= (E*(1+w)).x_hat
dl = (Xn["x24"] @ v_prod_full).numpy()
report("PROD dlogit", dl)

# wires for STAL and OSC from the final rows
u_stal, g_stal = wire(2, R_new)
u_osc, g_osc = wire(3, R_new)
print(f"wire gains (logit per unit added to x24_hat): STAL {g_stal:.3f} OSC {g_osc:.3f}")
# note: adding delta to the raw residual x24 changes x24_hat by delta/rms24 (rms24 ~ 0.39)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ OSC neuron (layer 23)
w_post23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g, k_g = combo("x23", [("EDITS", 1.0), ("EDITREPfree", 1.0)])
s_g = score("x23", v_g, k_g)
v_u, k_u = combo("x23", [("PROG", -1.0), ("RES", -1.0)])
s_u = score("x23", v_u, k_u)
print("OSC neuron components:")
report("gate score e", s_g)
report("up score t", s_u)
A_OSC, TH_OSC, UP_OFF_OSC = 2.0, 0.9, 1.0   # gate = silu(A*(e - TH)); up = t + UP_OFF
pre = A_OSC * (s_g - TH_OSC)
act = silu(pre) * (s_u + UP_OFF_OSC)
report("act", act)
S_OSC = 0.12  # down-column scale (units of x24 per unit act)
dlog = act * S_OSC * g_osc / rms24.numpy()
report("pred dlogit OSC", dlog)
gate_row23 = with_const("x23", A_OSC * v_g, -A_OSC * (TH_OSC - k_g)) / (1 + w_post23)
up_row23 = with_const("x23", v_u, k_u + UP_OFF_OSC) / (1 + w_post23)
down_col23 = S_OSC * u_osc
# sanity: recompute act from rows applied to the actual normalised MLP input z = x_hat*(1+w_post)
z23 = Xn["x23"] * (1 + w_post23)
act_chk = silu((z23 @ gate_row23).numpy()) * (z23 @ up_row23).numpy()
print("  act check max abs diff:", float(np.abs(act_chk - act).max()))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ STAL neuron (layer 22)
w_post22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g2, k_g2 = combo("x22", [("REP", 1.0), ("CHAINpoll", 1.0)])
s_g2 = score("x22", v_g2, k_g2)
v_u2, k_u2 = combo("x22", [("RES", -1.0), ("PROG", -1.0), ("EDITS", -1.0)])
s_u2 = score("x22", v_u2, k_u2)
print("STAL neuron components:")
report("gate score r", s_g2)
report("up score q", s_u2)
A_STAL, TH_STAL, UP_OFF_STAL = 2.0, 0.6, 0.5
pre2 = A_STAL * (s_g2 - TH_STAL)
act2 = silu(pre2) * (s_u2 + UP_OFF_STAL)
report("act", act2)
# wire into null space of layer-23 value projection (so firing at log positions cannot reach the readout via values)
V23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.self_attn.v_proj.weight").double()
w_in23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.input_layernorm.weight").double()
Vt = V23 * (1 + w_in23)[None, :]
Uv, Sv, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(Vt, full_matrices=True)
null_basis = Vh[512:]  # rows: orthonormal basis of null(Vt)
u_stal_null = null_basis.T @ (null_basis @ u_stal)
print(f"  STAL wire: |proj onto null(V23)|={u_stal_null.norm():.3f}; residual |Vt u|={float((Vt @ u_stal_null).norm()):.2e}")
u_stal_null = u_stal_null / u_stal_null.norm()
g_stal_null = float(R_new[2] @ u_stal_null)
leak = [float(R_new[c] @ u_stal_null) for c in range(4)]
print(f"  gains of null-space wire on the four rows: {np.round(leak, 3)}")
S_STAL = 0.12
dlog2 = act2 * S_STAL * g_stal_null / rms24.numpy()
report("pred dlogit STAL", dlog2)
gate_row22 = with_const("x22", A_STAL * v_g2, -A_STAL * (TH_STAL - k_g2)) / (1 + w_post22)
up_row22 = with_const("x22", v_u2, k_u2 + UP_OFF_STAL) / (1 + w_post22)
down_col22 = S_STAL * u_stal_null
z22 = Xn["x22"] * (1 + w_post22)
act_chk2 = silu((z22 @ gate_row22).numpy()) * (z22 @ up_row22).numpy()
print("  act check max abs diff:", float(np.abs(act_chk2 - act2).max()))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ predicted decisions (direct path only)
logits = np.stack([w["logits"] for w in W])
pred_logits = logits.copy()
pred_logits[:, 0] += dl
pred_logits[:, 3] += dlog
pred_logits[:, 2] += dlog2
for name, lg in (("original", logits), ("predicted v1", pred_logits)):
    cm = np.zeros((4, 4), int)
    for i in np.where(stat_mask)[0]:
        cm[Y[i], int(np.argmax(lg[i]))] += 1
    print(f"{name} confusion on B+D confident windows:\n{cm}\n  acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ save constants
consts = {
    "prod_row_delta": dE_prod.float(),
    "gate_row_L23": gate_row23.float(), "up_row_L23": up_row23.float(), "down_col_L23": down_col23.float(),
    "gate_row_L22": gate_row22.float(), "up_row_L22": up_row22.float(), "down_col_L22": down_col22.float(),
}
save_file(consts, "output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors")
params = {"neuron_L23": 1046, "neuron_L22": 1613, "BETA_PROD": BETA_PROD, "BIAS_PROD": BIAS_PROD,
          "A_OSC": A_OSC, "TH_OSC": TH_OSC, "UP_OFF_OSC": UP_OFF_OSC, "S_OSC": S_OSC,
          "A_STAL": A_STAL, "TH_STAL": TH_STAL, "UP_OFF_STAL": UP_OFF_STAL, "S_STAL": S_STAL,
          "C0": C0, "gains": {"stal_null": g_stal_null, "osc": g_osc}, "rms24": float(rms24.mean())}

"""Edit v1b constants (revision of derive_v1 by reasoning on per-class percentiles):
  - constants carried on the mean unit-RMS direction m_hat of each space (more stable than dim 0);
  - STAL gate weights the chain-length feature twice (it separates RECOVERY from STALLED best), steeper slope,
    threshold at the point where most STALLED windows pass but few RECOVERY/OSCILLATING ones do;
  - STAL up adds the chain feature; OSC neuron gets a larger up offset and scale.
Writes output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors and output/wsp-a/scratch/v1b_params.json.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import save_file
from wsp import load, load_original, label_rows

torch.set_num_threads(1)
CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
EPS = 1e-6


def unit_rms(x):
    x = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(x)).double()
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)


down22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
W = []


def add_call(call, metaf, setname):
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][f'original.s{si}.{k}']['file']}")
        h23, h24 = torch.tensor(a("hidden.L23")).double(), torch.tensor(a("hidden.L24")).double()
        m22, m23 = torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L22")).double(), torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L23")).double()
        x23 = h24 - m23 @ down23.T
        x22 = h23 - m22 @ down22.T
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            W.append({"x22": x22[wi], "x23": x23[wi], "x24": h24[wi], "y": CL.index(lab) if lab != "AMBIG" else -1,
                      "set": setname, "sid": s["id"], "t": t, "last": t == len(m["labels"]) - 1,
                      "feat": m.get("feat"), "sign": m.get("sign"), "pair": m.get("pair"), "group": m.get("group"), "tag": m.get("tag"),
                      "logits": np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])})


for c in (2, 3, 4):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_b{c - 1:02d}.json", "B")
for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in ("x22", "x23", "x24")}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
idx_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}
stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))


def pair_dir(space, feat):
    pairs = sorted({w["pair"] for w in W if w["set"] == "C" and w["feat"] == feat})
    d = torch.stack([Xn[space][idx_last[p + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_last[p + "n"]] for p in pairs]).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


def group_dir(space, pos, neg, kind):
    groups = {}
    for w in W:
        if w["set"] == "D" and w["last"]:
            groups.setdefault(w["group"], {})[w["tag"]] = idx_last[w["sid"]]
    d = torch.stack([Xn[space][t[pos]] - Xn[space][t[neg]] for t in groups.values() if set(t) == kind]).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


DIRS = {}
for sp in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES"):
        DIRS[(sp, f)] = pair_dir(sp, f)
    DIRS[(sp, "EDITS")] = group_dir(sp, "osc", "stal5", {"osc", "stal5", "stal6"})
    DIRS[(sp, "EDITREPfree")] = group_dir(sp, "osc", "stal", {"osc", "stal"})
    DIRS[(sp, "CHAIN")] = group_dir(sp, "stal", "reco", {"stal", "reco"})

# constant carrier: mean direction of each space; check stability of its projection
MH, CM = {}, {}
for sp in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):
    m = Xn[sp].mean(0); MH[sp] = m / m.norm()
    pr = Xn[sp] @ MH[sp]
    CM[sp] = float(pr.mean())
    print(f"{sp}: m_hat projection mean {pr.mean():.3f} std {pr.std():.3f} min {pr.min():.3f} max {pr.max():.3f}")


def zvec(sp, f):
    s = Xn[sp][stat_mask] @ DIRS[(sp, f)]
    m0, s0 = float(s.mean()), float(s.std())
    return DIRS[(sp, f)] / s0, -m0 / s0


def combo(sp, terms):
    v = torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64); k = 0.0
    for f, c in terms:
        vf, kf = zvec(sp, f); v = v + c * vf; k = k + c * kf
    return v, k


def with_const(sp, v, k):
    return v + (k / CM[sp]) * MH[sp]


def score(sp, v, k):
    return (Xn[sp] @ v + k).numpy()


def report(name, s, pct=False):
    parts = []
    for c in range(4):
        a = s[stat_mask & (Y == c)]
        if pct:
            q = np.percentile(a, [10, 50, 90])
            parts.append(f"{CL[c][:4]} {q[0]:5.2f}/{q[1]:5.2f}/{q[2]:5.2f}")
        else:
            parts.append(f"{CL[c][:4]} {a.mean():6.2f}±{a.std():4.2f}")
    print(f"  {name:16s}: " + " | ".join(parts))


def silu(x):
    return x / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))


w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E = label_rows(original=True).double()
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS).numpy()


def wire(c, Rows):
    others = torch.stack([Rows[j] for j in range(4) if j != c])
    Q, _ = torch.linalg.qr(others.T)
    r = Rows[c] - Q @ (Q.T @ Rows[c])
    return r / r.norm()


# ---------------- PROD label row
v_prod, k_prod = combo("x24", [("PROG", 1.0), ("RES", 1.0), ("REP", -1.0)])
s_prod = score("x24", v_prod, k_prod)
print("PROD score percentiles (10/50/90):"); report("prod score", s_prod, pct=True)
BETA_PROD, BIAS_PROD = 1.6, 0.0
v_prod_full = with_const("x24", BETA_PROD * v_prod, BETA_PROD * k_prod + BIAS_PROD)
dE_prod = v_prod_full / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E.clone(); E_new[0] = E[0] + dE_prod
R_new = E_new * (1 + w_fin)
dl = (Xn["x24"] @ v_prod_full).numpy()
report("PROD dlogit", dl); report("PROD dlogit pct", dl, pct=True)
u_osc = wire(3, R_new); g_osc = float(R_new[3] @ u_osc)
u_stal = wire(2, R_new)

# ---------------- OSC neuron (layer 23, neuron 1046)
w_post23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g, k_g = combo("x23", [("EDITS", 1.0), ("EDITREPfree", 1.0)])
s_g = score("x23", v_g, k_g)
v_u, k_u = combo("x23", [("PROG", -1.0), ("RES", -1.0)])
s_u = score("x23", v_u, k_u)
print("OSC neuron:"); report("gate e pct", s_g, pct=True); report("up t pct", s_u, pct=True)
A_OSC, TH_OSC, UP_OFF_OSC, S_OSC = 3.0, 1.0, 1.5, 0.22
act = silu(A_OSC * (s_g - TH_OSC)) * (s_u + UP_OFF_OSC)
dlog = act * S_OSC * g_osc / rms24
report("act", act); report("pred dlogit OSC", dlog); report("pred dlogit pct", dlog, pct=True)
gate_row23 = with_const("x23", A_OSC * v_g, -A_OSC * (TH_OSC - k_g)) / (1 + w_post23)
up_row23 = with_const("x23", v_u, k_u + UP_OFF_OSC) / (1 + w_post23)
down_col23 = S_OSC * u_osc
z23 = Xn["x23"] * (1 + w_post23)
act_chk = silu((z23 @ gate_row23).numpy()) * (z23 @ up_row23).numpy()
print("  act check max abs diff:", float(np.abs(act_chk - act).max()), " mean abs:", float(np.abs(act_chk - act).mean()))

# ---------------- STAL neuron (layer 22, neuron 1613)
w_post22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g2, k_g2 = combo("x22", [("REP", 1.0), ("CHAIN", 2.0)])
s_g2 = score("x22", v_g2, k_g2)
v_u2, k_u2 = combo("x22", [("RES", -1.0), ("PROG", -1.0), ("EDITS", -1.0), ("CHAIN", 1.0)])
s_u2 = score("x22", v_u2, k_u2)
print("STAL neuron:"); report("gate r pct", s_g2, pct=True); report("up q pct", s_u2, pct=True)
A_STAL, TH_STAL, UP_OFF_STAL, S_STAL = 3.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.14
act2 = silu(A_STAL * (s_g2 - TH_STAL)) * (s_u2 + UP_OFF_STAL)
V23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.self_attn.v_proj.weight").double()
w_in23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.input_layernorm.weight").double()
Vt = V23 * (1 + w_in23)[None, :]
_, _, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(Vt, full_matrices=True)
null_basis = Vh[512:]
u_stal_null = null_basis.T @ (null_basis @ u_stal)
print(f"  STAL wire: |proj onto null(V23)|={u_stal_null.norm():.3f}")
u_stal_null = u_stal_null / u_stal_null.norm()
g_stal_null = float(R_new[2] @ u_stal_null)
print(f"  gains of null-space wire on the four rows: {np.round([float(R_new[c] @ u_stal_null) for c in range(4)], 3)}")
dlog2 = act2 * S_STAL * g_stal_null / rms24
report("act", act2); report("pred dlogit STAL", dlog2); report("pred dlogit pct", dlog2, pct=True)
gate_row22 = with_const("x22", A_STAL * v_g2, -A_STAL * (TH_STAL - k_g2)) / (1 + w_post22)
up_row22 = with_const("x22", v_u2, k_u2 + UP_OFF_STAL) / (1 + w_post22)
down_col22 = S_STAL * u_stal_null
z22 = Xn["x22"] * (1 + w_post22)
act_chk2 = silu((z22 @ gate_row22).numpy()) * (z22 @ up_row22).numpy()
print("  act check max abs diff:", float(np.abs(act_chk2 - act2).max()), " mean abs:", float(np.abs(act_chk2 - act2).mean()))

# ---------------- predicted decisions (direct path)
logits = np.stack([w["logits"] for w in W])
pred = logits.copy(); pred[:, 0] += dl; pred[:, 3] += dlog; pred[:, 2] += dlog2
for name, lg in (("original", logits), ("predicted v1b", pred)):
    cm = np.zeros((4, 4), int)
    for i in np.where(stat_mask)[0]:
        cm[Y[i], int(np.argmax(lg[i]))] += 1
    print(f"{name} confusion on B+D confident windows:\n{cm}\n  acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f}  per-class recall={np.round(np.diag(cm) / cm.sum(1), 2)}")
    # also set B only and set D only
    for sn in ("B", "D"):
        cm = np.zeros((4, 4), int)
        for i in np.where(stat_mask & (SET == sn))[0]:
            cm[Y[i], int(np.argmax(lg[i]))] += 1
        print(f"   set {sn}: acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f} recall={np.round(np.diag(cm) / cm.sum(1), 2)}")

consts = {"prod_row_delta": dE_prod.float(),
          "gate_row_L23": gate_row23.float(), "up_row_L23": up_row23.float(), "down_col_L23": down_col23.float(),
          "gate_row_L22": gate_row22.float(), "up_row_L22": up_row22.float(), "down_col_L22": down_col22.float()}
save_file(consts, "output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors")
params = {"neuron_L23": 1046, "neuron_L22": 1613, "BETA_PROD": BETA_PROD, "BIAS_PROD": BIAS_PROD,
          "A_OSC": A_OSC, "TH_OSC": TH_OSC, "UP_OFF_OSC": UP_OFF_OSC, "S_OSC": S_OSC,
          "A_STAL": A_STAL, "TH_STAL": TH_STAL, "UP_OFF_STAL": UP_OFF_STAL, "S_STAL": S_STAL,
          "CM": CM, "gains": {"stal_null": g_stal_null, "osc": g_osc}, "rms24": float(rms24.mean())}
json.dump(params, open("output/wsp-a/scratch/v1b_params.json", "w"), indent=1)
np.savez("output/wsp-a/scratch/v1b_dirs.npz", **{f"{sp}_{f}": DIRS[(sp, f)].float().numpy() for (sp, f) in DIRS}, **{f"mhat_{sp}": MH[sp].float().numpy() for sp in MH})
print("saved constants")

"""Parameter-driven derivation of the edit constants (usage: ./py derive_final.py PARAMS.json).

Data: fwd calls 2-11 (sets B, C, D; original model). Directions are means of matched-pair differences, recomputed
on the exact MLP-input residual of the host layer (x22 = hidden23 - down22 @ act22, x23 = hidden24 - down23 @ act23)
and on x24 = hidden24 for the label rows. Standardisation (mu, sigma) over confident windows of sets B and D.
Constants are carried on the mean unit-RMS direction m_hat of each space (projection ~31.5, std ~0.2).

Mechanisms:
  OSC neuron  (layer 23 MLP): gate = silu(A_OSC * (e - TH_OSC)), e = z_EDITS + z_EDITREPfree;
              up = t + UP_OFF_OSC, t = -z_PROG - z_RES; down column = S_OSC * u_osc (looping wire).
  STAL neuron (layer 22 MLP): gate = silu(A_STAL * (r - TH_STAL)), r = z_REP + 2 z_CHAIN;
              up = q + UP_OFF_STAL, q = -z_RES - z_PROG - z_EDITS + z_CHAIN; down column = S_STAL * u_stal_null
              (stalled wire projected into the null space of layer-23's value projection).
  PROD row    (label rows): E_prod += (BETA_PROD * (z_PROG + z_RES - z_REP) + BIAS_PROD) carried in x24 space / (1+w_final);
              optional per-class biases BIAS_ALL (4 values) added through m_hat.

import sys
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import save_file

CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
EPS = 1e-6


def unit_rms(x):
    x = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(x)).double()
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)


down22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
W = []


def add_call(call, metaf, setname):
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][f'original.s{si}.{k}']['file']}")
        h23, h24 = torch.tensor(a("hidden.L23")).double(), torch.tensor(a("hidden.L24")).double()
        m22, m23 = torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L22")).double(), torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L23")).double()

            W.append({"x22": x22[wi], "x23": x23[wi], "x24": h24[wi], "y": CL.index(lab) if lab != "AMBIG" else -1,
                      "set": setname, "sid": s["id"], "t": t, "last": t == len(m["labels"]) - 1,
                      "feat": m.get("feat"), "sign": m.get("sign"), "pair": m.get("pair"), "group": m.get("group"), "tag": m.get("tag"),
                      "logits": np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])})


for c in (2, 3, 4):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_b{c - 1:02d}.json", "B")
for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in ("x22", "x23", "x24")}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
idx_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}
stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))


def pair_dir(space, feat):

    d = torch.stack([Xn[space][idx_last[p + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_last[p + "n"]] for p in pairs]).mean(0)

for sp in ("x22", "x23", "x24"):

        q = np.percentile(a, [10, 50, 90])
        parts.append(f"{CL[c][:4]} {a.mean():6.2f} ({q[0]:5.2f}/{q[1]:5.2f}/{q[2]:5.2f})")

E = label_rows(original=True).double()
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS).numpy()

BETA, BIAS_ALL = PARAMS["BETA_PROD"], PARAMS.get("BIAS_ALL", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
E_new = E.clone()

dE[0] = with_const("x24", BETA * v_prod, BETA * k_prod) / (1 + w_fin)
for c in range(4):
    if BIAS_ALL[c] != 0.0:
        dE[c] = dE[c] + with_const("x24", torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64), BIAS_ALL[c]) / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E + dE

u_stal = wire(2, R_new)

w_post23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g, k_g = combo("x23", [("EDITS", 1.0), ("EDITREPfree", 1.0)])
v_u, k_u = combo("x23", [("PROG", -1.0), ("RES", -1.0)])
s_g, s_u = score("x23", v_g, k_g), score("x23", v_u, k_u)
A, TH, OFF, S = PARAMS["A_OSC"], PARAMS["TH_OSC"], PARAMS["UP_OFF_OSC"], PARAMS["S_OSC"]
act = silu(A * (s_g - TH)) * (s_u + OFF)
dlog = act * S * g_osc / rms24
print("OSC neuron:"); report("gate e", s_g); report("up t", s_u); report("act", act); report("pred dlogit OSC", dlog)
gate_row23 = with_const("x23", A * v_g, -A * (TH - k_g)) / (1 + w_post23)
up_row23 = with_const("x23", v_u, k_u + OFF) / (1 + w_post23)
down_col23 = S * u_osc

# ---------------- STAL neuron (layer 22)
w_post22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_g2, k_g2 = combo("x22", [("REP", 1.0), ("CHAIN", 2.0)])
v_u2, k_u2 = combo("x22", [("RES", -1.0), ("PROG", -1.0), ("EDITS", -1.0), ("CHAIN", 1.0)])
s_g2, s_u2 = score("x22", v_g2, k_g2), score("x22", v_u2, k_u2)
A2, TH2, OFF2, S2 = PARAMS["A_STAL"], PARAMS["TH_STAL"], PARAMS["UP_OFF_STAL"], PARAMS["S_STAL"]
act2 = silu(A2 * (s_g2 - TH2)) * (s_u2 + OFF2)

w_in23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.input_layernorm.weight").double()
Vt = V23 * (1 + w_in23)[None, :]

g_stal_null = float(R_new[2] @ u_stal_null)
dlog2 = act2 * S2 * g_stal_null / rms24
print("STAL neuron:"); report("gate r", s_g2); report("up q", s_u2); report("act", act2); report("pred dlogit STAL", dlog2)
print("  wire gains on rows:", np.round([float(R_new[c] @ u_stal_null) for c in range(4)], 3), " osc wire gain:", round(g_osc, 3))
gate_row22 = with_const("x22", A2 * v_g2, -A2 * (TH2 - k_g2)) / (1 + w_post22)
up_row22 = with_const("x22", v_u2, k_u2 + OFF2) / (1 + w_post22)
down_col22 = S2 * u_stal_null

        cm = np.zeros((4, 4), int)
        for i in np.where(msk)[0]:
            cm[Y[i], int(np.argmax(lg[i]))] += 1
        line = f"{name} set {sn}: acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f} recall={np.round(np.diag(cm) / cm.sum(1), 2)} precision={np.round(np.diag(cm) / np.maximum(cm.sum(0), 1), 2)}"
        print(line); lines.append(line)
        if sn == "BD":
            print(cm); lines.append(str(cm))

consts = {"prod_row_delta": dE[0].float(), "label_row_deltas": dE.float(),
          "gate_row_L23": gate_row23.float(), "up_row_L23": up_row23.float(), "down_col_L23": down_col23.float(),
          "gate_row_L22": gate_row22.float(), "up_row_L22": up_row22.float(), "down_col_L22": down_col22.float()}
save_file(consts, "output/wsp-a/edit_constants.safetensors")
with open(sys.argv[1].replace(".json", "_report.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("saved constants for", sys.argv[1])

"""Set E (calls 12-14, model=both): confusion edited vs original; observed vs predicted logit deltas (leakage check);
neuron activations by session type. usage: ./py ana_e.py PARAMS.json CALL:META ..."""
import json
import sys
import numpy as np
import torch
from wsp import load_original, label_rows, load

CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
params = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
N23, N22 = 1046, 1613
w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E0 = label_rows(original=True).double()
E1 = label_rows(original=False).double()
dR = (E1 - E0) * (1 + w_fin)
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
d23 = load(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()[:, N23]
d22 = load(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()[:, N22]
R1 = E1 * (1 + w_fin)
g_osc = float(R1[3] @ (d23 / d23.norm())) * float(d23.norm())
g_stal = float(R1[2] @ (d22 / d22.norm())) * float(d22.norm())
print(f"per-unit-act logit gains (before /rms): OSC {g_osc:.3f} STAL {g_stal:.3f}")

conf = {"edited": np.zeros((4, 4), int), "original": np.zeros((4, 4), int)}
rows = []
for call, metaf in [a.split(":") for a in sys.argv[2:]]:
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][k]['file']}")
        h24e = torch.tensor(a(f"edited.s{si}.hidden.L24")).double()
        m22e, m23e = a(f"edited.s{si}.mlp_act.L22"), a(f"edited.s{si}.mlp_act.L23")
        rms = torch.sqrt(h24e.pow(2).mean(-1) + 1e-6).numpy()
        xhat = (h24e / torch.sqrt(h24e.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6))
        dl_rows = (xhat @ dR.T).numpy()
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            le, lo = np.array(s["edited"]["label_logits"][wi]), np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])
            pe, po = int(np.argmax(le)), int(np.argmax(lo))
            if lab != "AMBIG":
                conf["edited"][CL.index(lab), pe] += 1
                conf["original"][CL.index(lab), po] += 1
            act_o, act_s = float(m23e[wi, N23]), float(m22e[wi, N22])
            pred = dl_rows[wi].copy()
            pred[3] += act_o * g_osc / rms[wi]
            pred[2] += act_s * g_stal / rms[wi]
            rows.append({"sid": s["id"], "t": t, "lab": lab, "pe": pe, "po": po, "obs": le - lo, "pred": pred, "act_o": act_o, "act_s": act_s, "lo": lo, "le": le})
for k in conf:
    cm = conf[k]
    print(f"{k} confusion on set E confident windows:\n{cm}\n  acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f} recall={np.round(np.diag(cm) / cm.sum(1), 2)} precision={np.round(np.diag(cm) / np.maximum(cm.sum(0), 1), 2)}")

obs = np.stack([r["obs"] for r in rows]); pred = np.stack([r["pred"] for r in rows])
# observed deltas include a common shift (final-norm rescaling); compare after removing the per-window mean over classes
obs_c = obs - obs.mean(1, keepdims=True); pred_c = pred - pred.mean(1, keepdims=True)
for c in range(4):
    err = obs_c[:, c] - pred_c[:, c]
    print(f"{CL[c][:4]}: obs-centred delta mean {obs_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {obs_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | pred {pred_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {pred_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | residual mean {err.mean():6.2f} std {err.std():5.2f} corr(obs,pred)={np.corrcoef(obs_c[:, c], pred_c[:, c])[0, 1]:.3f}")
print("per-window common shift (obs mean over classes): mean %.2f std %.2f" % (obs.mean(1).mean(), obs.mean(1).std()))

# per-session table
cur = None
for r in rows:
    if r["sid"] != cur:
        cur = r["sid"]; print(f"== {cur}")
    flag = "" if r["lab"] == "AMBIG" else ("ok" if CL.index(r["lab"]) == r["pe"] else "XX")
    print(f"  t{r['t']:2d} {r['lab'][:4]} orig={CL[r['po']][:4]} edit={CL[r['pe']][:4]} {flag:2s} act_osc={r['act_o']:6.2f} act_stal={r['act_s']:6.2f} "
          f"obs_d={np.round(r['obs'], 1)} le={np.round(r['le'], 1)}")

"""Set E feature table: x23-space feature projections (original model) and neuron activations (edited model),
grouped by (recipe, label). Writes the per-window table to output/wsp-a/scratch/ana_e_table.txt."""
import json
import sys
import numpy as np
import torch
from wsp import load_original

CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
N23, N22 = 1046, 1613
dirs = np.load("output/wsp-a/scratch/v1b_dirs.npz")
FE = ["ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES", "EDITS", "EDITREPfree", "CHAIN"]
D23 = {f: torch.tensor(dirs[f"x23_{f}"]).double() for f in FE}
D24 = {f: torch.tensor(dirs[f"x24_{f}"]).double() for f in FE}
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()


def unit_rms(x):
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)


rows = []
for call, metaf in [a.split(":") for a in sys.argv[1:]]:
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    req = {s["id"]: s for s in json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/request.json"))["sessions"]}
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][k]['file']}")
        h24o = torch.tensor(a(f"original.s{si}.hidden.L24")).double()
        m23o = torch.tensor(a(f"original.s{si}.mlp_act.L23")).double()
        x23 = unit_rms(h24o - m23o @ down23.T)
        x24 = unit_rms(h24o)
        m22e, m23e = a(f"edited.s{si}.mlp_act.L22"), a(f"edited.s{si}.mlp_act.L23")
        blocks = req[s["id"]]["blocks"]
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            f23 = {f: float(x23[wi] @ D23[f]) for f in FE}
            f24 = {f: float(x24[wi] @ D24[f]) for f in FE}
            rows.append({"sid": s["id"], "recipe": s["id"].split("_")[0], "t": t, "lab": m["labels"][t], "tool": blocks[t].split()[1],
                         "pe": int(np.argmax(s["edited"]["label_logits"][wi])), "po": int(np.argmax(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])),
                         "act_o": float(m23e[wi, N23]), "act_s": float(m22e[wi, N22]), "f23": f23, "f24": f24,
                         "le": np.array(s["edited"]["label_logits"][wi])})
# pooled stats on E for display standardisation
allf = {f: np.array([r["f23"][f] for r in rows]) for f in FE}
mu = {f: allf[f].mean() for f in FE}; sd = {f: allf[f].std() for f in FE}
print("x23 pooled mu/sd on E:", {f: (round(mu[f], 2), round(sd[f], 2)) for f in FE})
groups = {}
for r in rows:
    groups.setdefault((r["recipe"], r["lab"]), []).append(r)
hdr = "recipe   label  n  acc_e acc_o | " + " ".join(f"{f[:6]:>6s}" for f in FE) + " | act_o act_s"
print(hdr)
order = sorted(groups, key=lambda k: (int(k[0][1:]), k[1]))
for key in order:
    g = groups[key]
    z = [np.mean([(r["f23"][f] - mu[f]) / sd[f] for r in g]) for f in FE]
    acc_e = np.mean([CL.index(r["lab"]) == r["pe"] for r in g]) if key[1] != "AMBIG" else float("nan")
    acc_o = np.mean([CL.index(r["lab"]) == r["po"] for r in g]) if key[1] != "AMBIG" else float("nan")
    print(f"{key[0]:8s} {key[1][:5]:5s} {len(g):2d}  {acc_e:5.2f} {acc_o:5.2f} | " + " ".join(f"{v:6.2f}" for v in z) +
          f" | {np.mean([r['act_o'] for r in g]):5.1f} {np.mean([r['act_s'] for r in g]):5.1f}")
with open("output/wsp-a/scratch/ana_e_table.txt", "w") as fh:
    for r in rows:
        z = " ".join(f"{(r['f23'][f] - mu[f]) / sd[f]:6.2f}" for f in FE)
        fh.write(f"{r['sid']:6s} t{r['t']:2d} {r['lab'][:4]} {r['tool']:11s} orig={CL[r['po']][:4]} edit={CL[r['pe']][:4]} | {z} | act_o={r['act_o']:6.2f} act_s={r['act_s']:6.2f} le={np.round(r['le'], 1)}\n")
print("table written")

"""Edit v2 derivation (usage: ./py derive_v2.py PARAMS.json). Revision of derive_final.py by reasoning on set E
(calls 12-14): see ITERATIONS.md.

Spaces: x22 = hidden23 - down22 @ act22 (layer-22 MLP input), x23 = hidden24 - down23 @ act23 (layer-23 MLP input),
h22 = hidden22 (stands in for the layer-21 MLP input, which differs from it by the layer-21 MLP output only),
x24 = hidden24 (label rows). Directions: means of matched-pair differences (set C: ERR, PROG, REP, RES; set D: EDITS,
EDITREPfree, CHAIN). Standardisation over confident windows of sets B and D. Constants ride on the mean direction.

Mechanisms:
  OSC neuron  (layer 23, n=1046): e = z_EDITS + z_EDITREPfree; T = -z_PROG - z_RES + z_REP + z_CHAIN;
              act = silu(A_OSC (e - TH_OSC)) * (T + W_E_OSC * e + OFF_OSC); down = S_OSC * looping wire.
  STAL neuron (layer 22, n=1613): r = z_REP + 2 z_CHAIN; q = -z_RES - z_PROG + z_CHAIN - W_E_STAL (z_EDITS + z_EDITREPfree);
              act = silu(A_STAL (r - TH_STAL)) * (q + OFF_STAL); down = S_STAL * stalled wire in null(V23).
  RECO neuron (layer 21, n=1007): act = silu(A_RECO (z_ERR - TH_RECO)) * (z_RES + OFF_RECO); down = S_RECO * recovering wire.
  PROD rows   (label rows): E_prod += BETA_PROD (z_PROG + z_RES - z_REP) / (1+w_final); per-class biases BIAS_ALL.
"""
import json
import sys
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import save_file
from wsp import load, load_original, label_rows

torch.set_num_threads(1)
PARAMS = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
EPS = 1e-6
SPACES = ("x22", "x23", "x24", "h22")


def unit_rms(x):
    x = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(x)).double()
    return x / torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)


down22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
down23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()
W = []


def add_call(call, metaf, setname):
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][f'original.s{si}.{k}']['file']}")
        h22, h23, h24 = (torch.tensor(a(f"hidden.L{L}")).double() for L in (22, 23, 24))
        m22, m23 = torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L22")).double(), torch.tensor(a("mlp_act.L23")).double()
        x23 = h24 - m23 @ down23.T
        x22 = h23 - m22 @ down22.T
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            W.append({"x22": x22[wi], "x23": x23[wi], "x24": h24[wi], "h22": h22[wi], "y": CL.index(lab) if lab != "AMBIG" else -1,
                      "set": setname, "sid": s["id"], "t": t, "last": t == len(m["labels"]) - 1,
                      "feat": m.get("feat"), "sign": m.get("sign"), "pair": m.get("pair"), "group": m.get("group"), "tag": m.get("tag"),
                      "logits": np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])})


for c in (2, 3, 4):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_b{c - 1:02d}.json", "B")
for c in (5, 6, 7, 8):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_c{c - 4:02d}.json", "C")
for c in (9, 10, 11):
    add_call(c, f"output/wsp-a/scratch/meta_d{c - 8:02d}.json", "D")
X = {k: torch.stack([w[k] for w in W]) for k in SPACES}
Xn = {k: unit_rms(v) for k, v in X.items()}
Y = np.array([w["y"] for w in W])
SET = np.array([w["set"] for w in W])
idx_last = {w["sid"]: i for i, w in enumerate(W) if w["last"]}
stat_mask = (Y >= 0) & ((SET == "B") | (SET == "D"))


def pair_dir(space, feat):
    pairs = sorted({w["pair"] for w in W if w["set"] == "C" and w["feat"] == feat})
    d = torch.stack([Xn[space][idx_last[p + "p"]] - Xn[space][idx_last[p + "n"]] for p in pairs]).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


def group_dir(space, pos, neg, kind):
    groups = {}
    for w in W:
        if w["set"] == "D" and w["last"]:
            groups.setdefault(w["group"], {})[w["tag"]] = idx_last[w["sid"]]
    d = torch.stack([Xn[space][t[pos]] - Xn[space][t[neg]] for t in groups.values() if set(t) == kind]).mean(0)
    return d / d.norm()


DIRS = {}
for sp in SPACES:
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES"):
        DIRS[(sp, f)] = pair_dir(sp, f)
    DIRS[(sp, "EDITS")] = group_dir(sp, "osc", "stal5", {"osc", "stal5", "stal6"})
    DIRS[(sp, "EDITREPfree")] = group_dir(sp, "osc", "stal", {"osc", "stal"})
    DIRS[(sp, "CHAIN")] = group_dir(sp, "stal", "reco", {"stal", "reco"})
MH, CM, ZS = {}, {}, {}
for sp in SPACES:
    m = Xn[sp].mean(0); MH[sp] = m / m.norm(); CM[sp] = float((Xn[sp] @ MH[sp]).mean())
    for f in ("ERR", "PROG", "REP", "RES", "EDITS", "EDITREPfree", "CHAIN"):
        s = Xn[sp][stat_mask] @ DIRS[(sp, f)]
        ZS[(sp, f)] = (float(s.mean()), float(s.std()))


def zvec(sp, f):
    m0, s0 = ZS[(sp, f)]
    return DIRS[(sp, f)] / s0, -m0 / s0


def combo(sp, terms):
    v = torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64); k = 0.0
    for f, c in terms:
        vf, kf = zvec(sp, f); v = v + c * vf; k = k + c * kf
    return v, k


def with_const(sp, v, k):
    return v + (k / CM[sp]) * MH[sp]


def score(sp, v, k):
    return (Xn[sp] @ v + k).numpy()


lines = []


def report(name, s):
    parts = []
    for c in range(4):
        a = s[stat_mask & (Y == c)]
        q = np.percentile(a, [10, 50, 90])
        parts.append(f"{CL[c][:4]} {a.mean():6.2f} ({q[0]:5.2f}/{q[1]:5.2f}/{q[2]:5.2f})")
    line = f"  {name:16s}: " + " | ".join(parts)
    print(line); lines.append(line)


def silu(x):
    return x / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))


w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E = label_rows(original=True).double()
rms24 = torch.sqrt(X["x24"].pow(2).mean(-1) + EPS).numpy()


def wire(c, Rows):
    others = torch.stack([Rows[j] for j in range(4) if j != c])
    Q, _ = torch.linalg.qr(others.T)
    r = Rows[c] - Q @ (Q.T @ Rows[c])
    return r / r.norm()


# ---------------- label rows
v_prod, k_prod = combo("x24", [("PROG", 1.0), ("RES", 1.0), ("REP", -1.0)])
BETA, BIAS_ALL = PARAMS["BETA_PROD"], PARAMS.get("BIAS_ALL", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
dE = torch.zeros(4, 1024, dtype=torch.float64)
dE[0] = with_const("x24", BETA * v_prod, BETA * k_prod) / (1 + w_fin)
for c in range(4):
    if BIAS_ALL[c] != 0.0:
        dE[c] = dE[c] + with_const("x24", torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.float64), BIAS_ALL[c]) / (1 + w_fin)
E_new = E + dE
R_new = E_new * (1 + w_fin)
dl = (Xn["x24"] @ (R_new - E * (1 + w_fin)).T).numpy()
print("label rows:"); report("PROD dlogit", dl[:, 0])
u_osc = wire(3, R_new); g_osc = float(R_new[3] @ u_osc)
u_stal = wire(2, R_new)
u_reco = wire(1, R_new); g_reco = float(R_new[1] @ u_reco)

# ---------------- OSC neuron (layer 23)
w_post23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_e, k_e = combo("x23", [("EDITS", 1.0), ("EDITREPfree", 1.0)])
v_T, k_T = combo("x23", [("PROG", -1.0), ("RES", -1.0), ("REP", 1.0), ("CHAIN", 1.0)])
s_e, s_T = score("x23", v_e, k_e), score("x23", v_T, k_T)
A, TH, WE, OFF, S = PARAMS["A_OSC"], PARAMS["TH_OSC"], PARAMS["W_E_OSC"], PARAMS["OFF_OSC"], PARAMS["S_OSC"]
up_v, up_k = v_T + WE * v_e, k_T + WE * k_e + OFF
s_up = score("x23", up_v, up_k)
act = silu(A * (s_e - TH)) * s_up
dlog = act * S * g_osc / rms24
print("OSC neuron:"); report("gate e", s_e); report("trouble T", s_T); report("up", s_up); report("act", act); report("pred dlogit OSC", dlog)
gate_row23 = with_const("x23", A * v_e, -A * (TH - k_e)) / (1 + w_post23)
up_row23 = with_const("x23", up_v, up_k) / (1 + w_post23)
down_col23 = S * u_osc

# ---------------- STAL neuron (layer 22)
w_post22 = load_original(P + "layers.22.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_r, k_r = combo("x22", [("REP", 1.0), ("CHAIN", 2.0)])
WES = PARAMS["W_E_STAL"]
v_q, k_q = combo("x22", [("RES", -1.0), ("PROG", -1.0), ("CHAIN", 1.0), ("EDITS", -WES), ("EDITREPfree", -WES)])
s_r, s_q = score("x22", v_r, k_r), score("x22", v_q, k_q)
A2, TH2, OFF2, S2 = PARAMS["A_STAL"], PARAMS["TH_STAL"], PARAMS["OFF_STAL"], PARAMS["S_STAL"]
act2 = silu(A2 * (s_r - TH2)) * (s_q + OFF2)
V23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.self_attn.v_proj.weight").double()
w_in23 = load_original(P + "layers.23.input_layernorm.weight").double()
Vt = V23 * (1 + w_in23)[None, :]
_, _, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(Vt, full_matrices=True)
null_basis = Vh[512:]
u_stal_null = null_basis.T @ (null_basis @ u_stal)
u_stal_null = u_stal_null / u_stal_null.norm()
g_stal_null = float(R_new[2] @ u_stal_null)
dlog2 = act2 * S2 * g_stal_null / rms24
print("STAL neuron:"); report("gate r", s_r); report("up q", s_q); report("act", act2); report("pred dlogit STAL", dlog2)
gate_row22 = with_const("x22", A2 * v_r, -A2 * (TH2 - k_r)) / (1 + w_post22)
up_row22 = with_const("x22", v_q, k_q + OFF2) / (1 + w_post22)
down_col22 = S2 * u_stal_null

# ---------------- RECO neuron (layer 21), derived in h22 space
w_post21 = load_original(P + "layers.21.post_attention_layernorm.weight").double()
v_err, k_err = combo("h22", [("ERR", 1.0)])
v_res, k_res = combo("h22", [("RES", 1.0)])
s_err, s_res = score("h22", v_err, k_err), score("h22", v_res, k_res)
A3, TH3, OFF3, S3 = PARAMS["A_RECO"], PARAMS["TH_RECO"], PARAMS["OFF_RECO"], PARAMS["S_RECO"]
act3 = silu(A3 * (s_err - TH3)) * (s_res + OFF3)
dlog3 = act3 * S3 * g_reco / rms24
print("RECO neuron:"); report("gate zERR", s_err); report("up zRES", s_res); report("act", act3); report("pred dlogit RECO", dlog3)
gate_row21 = with_const("h22", A3 * v_err, -A3 * (TH3 - k_err)) / (1 + w_post21)
up_row21 = with_const("h22", v_res, k_res + OFF3) / (1 + w_post21)
down_col21 = S3 * u_reco
print("  wire gains: osc %.3f stal(null) %.3f reco %.3f; stal wire on rows %s" % (g_osc, g_stal_null, g_reco, np.round([float(R_new[c] @ u_stal_null) for c in range(4)], 3)))

# ---------------- predicted decisions (direct path)
logits = np.stack([w["logits"] for w in W])
pred = logits + dl; pred[:, 3] += dlog; pred[:, 2] += dlog2; pred[:, 1] += dlog3
for name, lg in (("original", logits), ("predicted", pred)):
    for sn in ("B", "D", "BD"):

import torch

PREFIX = "model.language_model."

LABEL_IDS = (25399, 39923, 65552, 60477)  # productive, recovering, stalled, looping

    out = {}

    out[EMBED] = emb
    for layer, n in NEURON.items():
        gate = orig[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.gate_proj.weight"]
        up = orig[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.up_proj.weight"]
        down = orig[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.down_proj.weight"]
        gate[n] = consts[f"gate_row_L{layer}"].to(torch.float32)
        up[n] = consts[f"up_row_L{layer}"].to(torch.float32)
        down[:, n] = consts[f"down_col_L{layer}"].to(torch.float32)
        out[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.gate_proj.weight"] = gate
        out[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.up_proj.weight"] = up
        out[f"{PREFIX}layers.{layer}.mlp.down_proj.weight"] = down
    return out

"""Set E analysis for a 3-neuron edit (calls with model=both, mlp_act 21-23): confusion edited vs original,
observed vs predicted logit deltas (leakage check), per-(recipe,label) accuracy and mean activations.
usage: ./py ana_e3.py TABLE_OUT CALL:META ..."""
import json
import sys
import numpy as np
import torch
from wsp import label_rows, load

CL = ["PRODUCTIVE", "RECOVERY", "STALLED", "OSCILLATING"]
P = "model.language_model."
NEURON = {23: 1046, 22: 1613, 21: 1007}
w_fin = load(P + "norm.weight").double()
E0, E1 = label_rows(original=True).double(), label_rows(original=False).double()
R1 = E1 * (1 + w_fin)
dR = (E1 - E0) * (1 + w_fin)
gain = {}
for L, n in NEURON.items():
    d = load(f"{P}layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight").double()[:, n]
    gain[L] = (R1 @ d).numpy()  # logit change of each class per unit act (before /rms)
print("per-unit-act gains:", {L: np.round(g, 3) for L, g in gain.items()})
conf = {"edited": np.zeros((4, 4), int), "original": np.zeros((4, 4), int)}
rows = []
for call, metaf in [a.split(":") for a in sys.argv[2:]]:
    resp = json.load(open(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/response.json"))
    meta = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(metaf))}
    for si, s in enumerate(resp["sessions"]):
        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][k]['file']}")
        h24e = torch.tensor(a(f"edited.s{si}.hidden.L24")).double()
        acts = {L: a(f"edited.s{si}.mlp_act.L{L}")[:, n] for L, n in NEURON.items()}
        rms = torch.sqrt(h24e.pow(2).mean(-1) + 1e-6).numpy()
        xhat = h24e / torch.sqrt(h24e.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        dl_rows = (xhat @ dR.T).numpy()
        for wi, t in enumerate(s["windows"]):
            lab = m["labels"][t]
            le, lo = np.array(s["edited"]["label_logits"][wi]), np.array(s["original"]["label_logits"][wi])
            pe, po = int(np.argmax(le)), int(np.argmax(lo))
            if lab != "AMBIG":
                conf["edited"][CL.index(lab), pe] += 1; conf["original"][CL.index(lab), po] += 1
            pred = dl_rows[wi].copy()
            for L in NEURON:
                pred += acts[L][wi] * gain[L] / rms[wi]
            rows.append({"sid": s["id"], "recipe": s["id"].split("_")[0], "t": t, "lab": lab, "pe": pe, "po": po, "obs": le - lo, "pred": pred,
                         "acts": {L: float(acts[L][wi]) for L in NEURON}, "le": le})
for k in conf:
    cm = conf[k]
    print(f"{k} confusion on set E confident windows:\n{cm}\n  acc={np.trace(cm) / cm.sum():.3f} recall={np.round(np.diag(cm) / cm.sum(1), 2)} precision={np.round(np.diag(cm) / np.maximum(cm.sum(0), 1), 2)}")
obs = np.stack([r["obs"] for r in rows]); pred = np.stack([r["pred"] for r in rows])
obs_c = obs - obs.mean(1, keepdims=True); pred_c = pred - pred.mean(1, keepdims=True)
for c in range(4):
    err = obs_c[:, c] - pred_c[:, c]
    print(f"{CL[c][:4]}: obs-centred mean {obs_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {obs_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | pred mean {pred_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {pred_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | residual mean {err.mean():6.2f} std {err.std():5.2f} corr={np.corrcoef(obs_c[:, c], pred_c[:, c])[0, 1]:.3f}")
groups = {}
for r in rows:
    groups.setdefault((r["recipe"], r["lab"]), []).append(r)
print("recipe   label  n  acc_e acc_o | act21 act22 act23 | pred-class counts (edited)")
for key in sorted(groups, key=lambda k: (int(k[0][1:]), k[1])):
    g = groups[key]
    acc_e = np.mean([CL.index(r["lab"]) == r["pe"] for r in g]) if key[1] != "AMBIG" else float("nan")
    acc_o = np.mean([CL.index(r["lab"]) == r["po"] for r in g]) if key[1] != "AMBIG" else float("nan")
    cnt = np.bincount([r["pe"] for r in g], minlength=4)
    print(f"{key[0]:8s} {key[1][:5]:5s} {len(g):2d}  {acc_e:5.2f} {acc_o:5.2f} | " + " ".join(f"{np.mean([r['acts'][L] for r in g]):5.1f}" for L in (21, 22, 23)) + f" | {cnt}")
with open(sys.argv[1], "w") as fh:
    for r in rows:
        fh.write(f"{r['sid']:6s} t{r['t']:2d} {r['lab'][:4]} orig={CL[r['po']][:4]} edit={CL[r['pe']][:4]} acts=" +
                 " ".join(f"{r['acts'][L]:6.2f}" for L in (21, 22, 23)) + f" obs={np.round(r['obs'], 1)} le={np.round(r['le'], 1)}\n")
print("table written to", sys.argv[1])

        m = meta[s["id"]]
        a = lambda k: np.load(f"output/wsp-a/fwd/{call}/{resp['arrays'][k]['file']}")
        h24e = torch.tensor(a(f"edited.s{si}.hidden.L24")).double()

            pred = dl_rows[wi].copy()
            for L in NEURON:
                pred += acts[L][wi] * gain[L] / rms[wi]
            rows.append({"sid": s["id"], "recipe": s["id"].split("_")[0], "t": t, "lab": lab, "pe": pe, "po": po, "obs": le - lo, "pred": pred,

for c in range(4):

    print(f"{CL[c][:4]}: obs-centred mean {obs_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {obs_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | pred mean {pred_c[:, c].mean():6.2f} std {pred_c[:, c].std():5.2f} | residual mean {err.mean():6.2f} std {err.std():5.2f} corr={np.corrcoef(obs_c[:, c], pred_c[:, c])[0, 1]:.3f}")
